verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any API, SDK, CLI, or webhook payload that returns call recordings or transcripts. The CLI and MCP server are said to 'manage calls', and HIPAA mode lets you 'control how call recordings and logs are stored'. Neither shows programmatic retrieval of recordings or transcripts for every call, so both are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can retrieve full call recordings and transcripts programmatically for every call
